name: Compare the headless game's trace with the Rust engine's

comments.text: Done: tests/host/the-platformer-matches-the-rust-trace compares every frame of a 600-frame autopilot run and a 240-frame walking run (menu, Enter, A, W) with Rust traces: player position, speed, grounded, camera yaw and pitch, gems, time and draw count. They match exactly (tolerance 0 at the game's own printed precision).
